Politics · India

Sonam Wangchuk begins hunger strike; Uddhav seeks MP disqualification

Activist Sonam Wangchuk has started an indefinite hunger strike at Jantar Mantar, citing the Centre's failure to respond to his demands. Meanwhile, Uddhav Thackeray has called for the disqualification of six rebel MPs, alleging a political conspiracy. Separately, reports indicate ongoing rainfall in Andhra Pradesh and a new health app initiative by the Centre.
